page_note: Page contains the tail of a previous chapter (segs 0-5, heavily ecclesial — elect, catechumens, church) and the opening of the chapter "Concerning the four great days" (segs 6-36). The four-day enumeration is structurally complete and cosmological. Editorial fatigue score is negative (substrate increases in second half) — consistent with frame-formula at top giving way to teaching exposition. Heavy damage (73%) but enumeration spine survives.
